content: Cloudflare security posture checks (per Cloudflare's own Security Center/Security Insights and community audit guides): SSL/TLS mode set to Full (strict) not Flexible, DNSSEC enabled, WAF Managed Rules enabled (not just Custom Rules) with no rules stuck in log-only mode, minimum TLS version >= 1.2, Always Use HTTPS enabled, API tokens scoped narrowly (not Global API Key) with permission groups limited to needed Zone/Account scopes and tokens rotated/expiring, rate limiting configured on auth/API endpoints, Bot Fight Mode or Bot Management enabled, origin server not directly exposed (origin IP hidden, orange-cloud proxy on for all records that don't need to bypass it). These map to Cloudflare's own dashboard 'Security' tab categories, making them straightforward to check via the Cloudflare API (zone settings + firewall rules endpoints) if live API access is later added.
